newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 26.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these
items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Authorities at Ivory Coast's biggest university, Cocody campus in the commercial capital Abidjan, ban all student meetings; security forces deployed on campus after clashes between students for and against a boycott of classes in long-running dispute over grants and academic and living

- Advertising agency Ogilvy and Mather World Wide, which has taken a 25 percent stake in Ivorian agency Ocean, aims to make it the biggest agency in Ivory Coast and Francophone Africa, Miles Young, Ogilvy and Mather executive committee member says - Caimpex Assinie, which brought part of privatised Ivorian agro-industrial giant Palmindustrie, said it has almost trippled production from its coconut plantations from 300 tonnes of copra

- Casual workers at Ivoire Industrie, a subsidiary of Ivorian cocoa and coffee company SICC (Societe Internationale de Cafe Cacao), demand payment of indemnities ahead of sale of the unit; Ivoire Industrie earmarked for sale to an American buyer.

- Official inquiry into bloody political and ethnic unrest surrounding opposition boycott of 1995 presidential election has completed its work; it will present its conclusions to President Henri Konan Bedie for action.
